visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A toddler boy with short dark hair and a striped shirt sits on a large wooden rocking horse. A young man with dark hair and a beige sweater sits next to him, smiling warmly. The setting is a minimalist indoor room with white walls. (2) The scene cuts to a low table with blue toy train tracks. The man and a woman with short blonde hair are playing with the child. Bright indoor lighting illuminates the scene. (3) A sequence of shots shows the woman hugging the child indoors, then walking outdoors with him in a beige baby carrier against a light-colored brick wall. (4) A close-up shot features a hand holding a white tube of La Roche-Posay cream. This is followed by a shot of a retail display shelf in a pharmacy or beauty store featuring the same product. (5) Close-up of pinkish cream being squeezed onto a hand, then the woman applying it to her cheek with her fingers. (6) A split-screen comparison appears, showing the woman's face labeled 'Before' (dull skin) and 'After' (brightened, even skin). (7) The woman is shown applying makeup over the product using a cushion puff, then smiling at the camera to show the finished look. (8) An extreme close-up focuses on the woman's cheek and jawline, highlighting the smooth, glowing texture of her skin. (9) A quick montage shows plates of fresh sushi and the woman drinking from a small cup in a dimly lit restaurant. (10) The young man from the first scene holds the product tube and points to his face, smiling. (11) The woman, carrying the child in the carrier again, waves at the camera in a hallway. The video ends with a shot of two different product tubes side-by-side.

(6) [Slogan]: 理膚寶水 全新升級新瑰蜜霜. (7) [Subtitle]: 就是日本媽媽們首選的妝前防曬之一. (8) [Slogan]: 日本研發 熱銷 No.1 TONE-UP UV. (9) [Subtitle]: 我自己大概會擠這麼多擦全臉. (10) [Subtitle]: 質地上起來很保濕不會黏黏的很負擔. (27) [Slogan]: 潤色自然輕透 超持久防曬力. (28) [Subtitle]: 還有所有喜歡日系淡雅妝容的朋友喔. (29) [Slogan]: 新瑰蜜霜 太空科技防曬. (30) [Subtitle]: 同系列也有太空科技防曬可以挑選!

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Friendly female narration begins over a bright, rhythmic acoustic guitar track. The tone is casual yet clear. (2) Vocal delivery remains consistent. Background music maintains a steady upbeat tempo. Subtle clicking sounds of plastic toys can be heard as the child plays. (3) A soft squishing sound indicates the product being dispensed, followed by the light friction sound of it being spread on skin. (4) Rhythmic 'thumping' sound of a makeup puff hitting the skin is audible beneath the narration. (5) Narration increases slightly in pitch and arousal to emphasize the beauty of the skin's glow. (6) Music continues cheerfully with piano accents until the final closing remarks, where it gently fades out.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Personal Experience -> Product Demo -> Call to Action
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote La Roche-Posay's Uvidea Anthelios Tone-Up UV cream by demonstrating its effectiveness for busy mothers seeking a quick and natural 'no-makeup' look.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct display of product branding, detailed explanation of usage and benefits, and close-up 'Before/After' comparisons.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video effectively bridges lifestyle vlogging with product promotion, using the relatable 'busy mom' persona to sell skincare efficiency.
